claims.statement: For odd-order group A=±P_i, nonzero unordered signed pairs modulo negation have exactly B^2 expression orbits, hence distinct pair-sum x-spectrum D≤B²
For nonzero R, signed four-sum existence iff H2(x(R))=0 or gcd(H2(V), Res_U(H2(U), S3(U,V,x(R))) mod H2(V))≠1; rational roots and zero-pair branches are required
On empty targets, H2(x(R))≠0 and extended Bezout identity AH2+BK=1 constitute checkable finite-field miss evidence for the frozen source base
For the explicit pair-spectrum resultant with D=Theta(B²), setup and query work have exponents sigma=tau=2 (up to logs); it does not meet conventional m4 full-row budget max(sigma,2)+tau<3
